select id,name,short_name,parent_id,path,level,sort,is_del,is_hide,create_user,create_time,update_time,update_user from t_department
name like concat('%',#{name},'%')

select t.id,t.name,t.short_name,t.parent_id,t.path,t.level,t.sort,t.is_del,t.is_hide,t.create_user,t.create_time,t.update_time,t.update_user, case when exists(select 1 from t_department c where c.path like concat(t.path, '/%') and (length(c.path) - length(replace(c.path, '/', ''))) = (length(t.path) - length(replace(t.path, '/', ''))) + 1) then 0 else 1 end as is_leaf from t_department t where t.path is not null and (length(t.path) - length(replace(t.path, '/', ''))) between 1 and 2 order by (length(t.path) - length(replace(t.path, '/', ''))) asc, t.sort asc, t.id asc

select t.id,t.name,t.short_name,t.parent_id,t.path,t.level,t.sort,t.is_del,t.is_hide,t.create_user,t.create_time,t.update_time,t.update_user, case when exists(select 1 from t_department c where c.path like concat(t.path, '/%') and (length(c.path) - length(replace(c.path, '/', ''))) = (length(t.path) - length(replace(t.path, '/', ''))) + 1) then 0 else 1 end as is_leaf from t_department t where t.path like concat(#{parentPath}, '/%') and (length(t.path) - length(replace(t.path, '/', ''))) = #{parentDepth} + 1 order by t.sort asc, t.id asc

select id,name,short_name,parent_id,level,sort,is_del,is_hide,create_user,create_time,update_time,update_user from t_department
name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
order by id desc

select count(1) from t_department
name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
